easyPrerequisites:
Sphinx's Disciple doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Tidewater Minion is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
description:
Activate Sphinx's Disciple using Tidewater Minion's ability by tapping it, untapping Sphinx's Disciple
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, drawing a card.
Repeat.
